services.name: Schedule A Tour
services.desc: Welcome to The Rustica! We are so excited to meet with you and help create your special event. Here at The Rustica, our aim is to make your venue selection completely effortless. Schedule a day & time with us by using the instant scheduler and choosing an available slot. We look forward to it! Once you’ve scheduled your tour at the Rustica-what’s next? Here’s what you can expect. Plan approximately an hour for the tour. Our experienced venue operator will meet you on-site and give you a tour of the grounds and the indoor facilities.
